She is a survivor. I don't understand her politics, but I respect her strength. Can we please not use her pain politically? Her pain is not a pawn, and survivors need to come together, not divide ourselves, in this. 

#JoniErnst
#MeToo

Let's not question why she's telling him now. We all share a different times - whatever works for us. She is brave af for sharing this at all, much less on this show. #caelynn @RAINN #thebachelor #metoo
